# Interview Snippets: Team Invite Controls

- Admins say contractors often join projects temporarily and should lose access
  automatically when their engagement ends.
- A workspace owner said: "I need to know who is still pending before I resend
  an invite; otherwise I spam people."
- Support reports that several enterprise customers block invites from personal
  email domains.
- Existing product already has workspace owner and workspace admin roles.
- Open issue: should workspace admins be allowed to cancel someone else's
  pending invite?
